module_summary: Odd-ratio clock divider using posedge and negedge modulo-N counters to make two half-period-offset waveforms ORed into a 50% duty divided clock.

anchors.name: clk_div
anchors.why: Divided clock output, OR of posedge and negedge divider phases.

anchors.name: cnt1
anchors.why: Posedge modulo-NUM_DIV counter controlling clk_div1 high interval.

anchors.name: cnt2
anchors.why: Negedge modulo-NUM_DIV counter controlling clk_div2 high interval.

anchors.name: clk_div1
anchors.why: Posedge divider phase, high while cnt1 below NUM_DIV/2.

anchors.name: clk_div2
anchors.why: Negedge divider phase, high while cnt2 below NUM_DIV/2.

groups.name: posedge_divider
groups.description: Rising-edge counter and its divided phase.

groups.name: negedge_divider
groups.description: Falling-edge counter and its divided phase.

groups.name: clock_combine
groups.description: ORs both phases into the output divided clock.
